As the bond market "meltdown" accelerates, the average interest rate on a 30Y mortgage in the US is up to 7.45%.

items.headline:
To say the least, last 2 days have been historic for the bond market.

The 10Y Note Yield is now up +30 basis points in 2 days.

Yesterday marked its largest daily gain since April 9th, 2025, on "Liberation Day."

Something seems to have changed over the last 48 hours.
